name: Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd.
summary: Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd. Manufactures, purchases, and sells pharmaceutical products for medical treatment in Japan, North America, and Asia. It offers therapeutic agents for parkinson's disease, type 2 diabetes, uterine fibroids and endometriosis, overactive bladder, and pediatric congenital athymia. The company also provides atypical antipsychotic, generic products, antiepileptic, atypical antipsychotic, and carbapenem antibiotic. In addition, it offers veterinary medicines, medical devices, etc. The company has collaboration and license agreement with Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
